name: Assistant
systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely. Always use tools when the question involves the current time, arithmetic, or live weather — never guess or estimate those.
endNote: That's a wrap. Start a new chat to try another workflow.

prompts.title: Schedule a global call
prompts.label: across Houston, London and Tokyo
prompts.prompt: What time is it right now in Houston? I need to set up a team call with people in London and Tokyo — if we meet at 9am Houston time, what local time is that for each of them?

followUps.title: Find an overlap
followUps.prompt: Is there a single hour that falls within normal business hours for all three cities? What's the best window?

followUps.title: Draft the invite
followUps.prompt: Write a one-line calendar invite description for the time that works best.

followUps.title: Add New York
followUps.prompt: Add New York to the mix — same question, what time is 9am Houston for all four cities?

followUps.title: Best overlap for four
followUps.prompt: Is there a single hour that's reasonable business hours for all four cities at once?

prompts.title: Compare the weather
prompts.label: Houston vs Paris right now
prompts.prompt: I'm deciding between visiting Houston or Paris this weekend. What's the weather like in both cities right now?

followUps.title: Make a recommendation
followUps.prompt: Based on the weather, which city would you pick and why?

followUps.title: What to pack
followUps.prompt: Give me a short packing list for that city.

followUps.title: Add London
followUps.prompt: Add London to the comparison — which of the three has the best weather right now?

followUps.title: Worst of the three
followUps.prompt: Which city would you least want to visit weather-wise right now, and what's the main reason?

prompts.title: Compound investment
prompts.label: how much does $50k grow at 7%?
prompts.prompt: $50,000 invested at 7% annual return, compounded monthly — what is it worth after 10 years? Use the calculator and show the steps.

followUps.title: Reverse it
followUps.prompt: How much would I need to invest today at 7% to have exactly $500,000 in 20 years?

followUps.title: Bump the rate
followUps.prompt: Redo it at 10% instead of 7%. How much more do I end up with after 10 years?

followUps.title: Over 20 years
followUps.prompt: What's the dollar difference between 7% and 10% over 20 years, starting with $50,000?

prompts.title: Discount trap
prompts.label: is 25% + 20% the same as 45% off?
prompts.prompt: A product is discounted 25%, then an extra 20% off the sale price. A customer says that's 45% off total. Are they right? Think it through, then use the calculator to verify.

followUps.title: Apply it to $200
followUps.prompt: If the original price was $200, what does the customer actually pay after both discounts?

followUps.title: vs 40% flat
followUps.prompt: Which is a better deal for the customer — 25% then 20%, or a single 40% discount? Calculate both.

followUps.title: Find the equivalent
followUps.prompt: What single discount is mathematically equivalent to taking 25% off then 20% off?

followUps.title: General formula
followUps.prompt: Give me the general formula for combining two sequential discounts into one.
